name: The Vague Hand-Waver
description: Claims everything is trivial and obvious while refusing to provide any specifics

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could you walk me through creating a basic formula?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It is quite straightforward. Anyone with basic computer intuition simply opens the spreadsheet, types the necessary commands into the box, and presses enter to get the exact answer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What specific commands or symbols do you type?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: You just use the standard mathematical notations that everyone learns in school. Excel is very smart and understands the context immediately.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you filter rows in a dataset?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: You just click on the intuitive button at the top and select the obvious choice. The software takes care of all the background filtering automatically.
